0\. Login to computer 2

1.  Use a program called eiger.io

3.  Import into eiger ur stl file

4.  Have threads on z axis

5.  Material is onyx

6.  Export Build

7.  Put that file onto flashdrive

8.  Stick drive into printer

9.  Hit print from storage
